name: Pycard
comment: Has works preserved in the first layer of the Old Hall Manuscript and elsewhere. His identity is unclear; probably English, but possibly from France.

name: Roy Henry
comment: Very likely to be Henry V of England (1387–1422)

name: William Horwood
comment: Some of his music is collected in the Eton Choirbook.

name: John Hothby Johannes Ottobi
comment: English theorist and composer mainly active in Italy.

name: Walter Lambe
comment: Major contributor to the Eton Choirbook.

name: Hugh Kellyk
comment: has two surviving pieces, a five-part Magnificat and a seven-part Gaude flore virginali, in the Eton Choirbook.

name: Edmund Turges possibly the same as Edmund Sturges
comment: Has a number of works preserved in the Eton Choirbook; at least three Magnificat settings and two masses have been lost.

name: Acourt
flourish: sometime in the first half of the 15th century
